Name: Maggs Sam Friendship Expansion Dialogue and Events
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]![b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]

Quick Links[/size][/color][/b]
Looking for the Romance version? Here it is! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41190]Magg's Immersive Sam Romance Core[/url]

[color=#6d9eeb][b][size=4]IMPORTANT!! Updating[/size][/b][/color]
This version is a complete event update, all the events are new or updated.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768198861.png[/img]
Friendship dialogue and event expansion for Sam, adding character depth and WAY more lines and events up to 8 hearts.
Sam's friendship with the farmer grows with his heart levels as he matures and changes, focusing on his music and friendships. Join Sam's adventures with Vince and his friends.

[color=#6d9eeb][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Nearly a full replacement of Sam's vanilla dialogue along with a massive expansion up to 8 hearts. Includes unique dialogue for Sam nearly every day the first year.[/*]
[*]Unique dialogue for festivals for the first 2 years, updated lines for events like Green Rain, Ginger Island, Community Center, etc.[/*]
[*]Randomized rain and saloon dialogue based on heart level.[/*]
[*]Over 20 story events plus updates to vanilla events, including two story series arcs and several cutscenes (mini-events with little or no dialogue)[/*]
[*]Sam keeps his vanilla pronouns/identity, this will not be changed.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768199233.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768199442.png[/img]
[b]Farmer neutral pronouns[/b]
Select 'Yes' to use gender neutral pronouns for farmer.

[b]Sam custom sprites[/b]
Select 'Yes' to enable Sam's custom sprites for a few small events, only works if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41138]Maggs Sam Sprites[/url], DSV, or Maggs Slightly Cuter sprite patch installed.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768199288.png[/img]
Compatible with most mods, including SVE.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39885]MH Event List[/url]﻿ Functions like Event Lookup, but includes many more features and shows the time gaps between events. NOTE: Set the filters to: Sam, Content Patcher, Relationship Events. Not all events show 100% of the time with 100% accuracy, this mod has its limits.

Do NOT copy and re-post this mod elsewhere without requesting permission. Copyright is a thing. This mod is 100% my own work.

[b]Translation: [/b]This mod includes an i18n file, so it is translation-friendly. You do not need to ask for permission to translate, just make sure to add this mod as a dependency so people can find the translation.
